Warm ivory background, dark charcoal text, deep teal and pale aqua accents, crisp flat editorial technical illustration, restrained rounded cards, generous margins, highly readable sans serif labels. Title: "One evaluation, end to end". A clear vertical flow of six wide compact horizontal cards connected by downward arrows, centered with small illustrative icons alongside labels. Exact ordered labels: "1  Skill + prompt + fixtures", "2  Fresh Git workspace", "3  Coding agent", "4  Generated files", "5  Vitest graders", "6  Result + evidence". Under card 3 small text "Claude Code · Codex · Copilot". Under card 5 small text "Inspect the output". At bottom exact takeaway: "A completed process is not a passing evaluation." Keep every label legible, arrows unambiguous, no fake screenshots, no brand logos, no decorative robots, no additional text. Output a finished raster image.
